verdict.rationale: Jan explicitly supports local model downloads (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, etc.) alongside cloud provider integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax) within the same interface, with docs framing it as choosing between open or online models. Community mention corroborates real-world use as a chat interface unifying these options. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of simultaneously mixing local and cloud models in a single session/assistant, and more detailed docs on provider configuration UX.
